# ioriver_client_mtls_trust_store (Resource)

Account-scoped CA trust bundle for client mTLS. Trust stores are immutable; changing name or bundle replaces the resource. Use `lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }` when referenced by a service so the service can switch to the replacement before the old trust store is deleted. Deletion fails while any enabled service references the trust store.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ioriver_client_mtls_trust_store" "clients" {
  name   = "trusted-clients"
  bundle = file("${path.module}/certs/client-ca-bundle.pem")

  # Create the replacement before switching service references and deleting the old store.
  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}

resource "ioriver_service" "mtls" {
  name         = "client-mtls-service"
  certificates = [ioriver_certificate.cert.id]

  config = {
    protocol = {
      enable_viewer_mtls        = true
      viewer_mtls_truststore_id = ioriver_client_mtls_trust_store.clients.id
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bundle` (String) PEM-encoded CA certificate bundle used to authenticate clients. Do not include private keys. Stored in Terraform state. Changing this value requires replacement. Import reads the backend's bundle with outer whitespace trimmed.
- `name` (String) Trust store name. Changing this value requires replacement.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Client mTLS trust store identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Client mTLS trust stores can be imported by specifying the trust-store UUID.
terraform import ioriver_client_mtls_trust_store.example "32489068-0ad6-4823-8c5d-9f4e4c458f93"
```
